reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is visual theming for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, centered on neon-style styling and configurable panel/media-backed backgrounds, while also exposing local config-management actions and media handling through host routes.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的主题插件，用于提供合成波风格的界面视觉效果，并支持字体缩放与可配置的图片/视频背景。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that applies a synthwave-style theme, including visual effects and configurable image or video background support with font scaling.

capabilities: Applies a user-facing visual theme to the DSH web interface (glow effects, translucent panels, font scaling, adaptive tokens)
Provides host endpoints to read config, open config location, remove media entries, and serve configured media bytes
Reads and updates a profile-scoped JSONC configuration file via plugin UI actions
Loads and serves local image/video media assets as background sources

reasons.code: DSH plugin exposes local service routes for config retrieval and media operations, which introduces write/read side effects beyond pure styling behavior.
Plugin creates and parses a profile-local config file and updates it for remove/save operations, which affects persistent user configuration.
Repository explicitly defines a host/client split and DSH plugin integration, confirming this is an installable DSH extension for web UI customization.
Package metadata declares DSH web client platform and bundle entry points, supporting the described runtime integration.
